answer: An identity requires a 500-unit stake locked in escrow plus a hardware credential unique per device, so no agent can hold a hollow registration without both. A detected fake identity forfeits 100 percent of its stake and waits 30 epochs before re-registering, costing more than the identity yields. Splitting identities multiplies the 500-unit marginal cost per fake, and independent jurors review attestation logs to flag any dune or lagoon of credentials tracing to one device.
